description: REQ-008 step 6 (behavioral-spec.md lines 206-210) requires run.sh to write a sidecar containing the STABILIZED before-hrefs snapshot ('...stabilized before["hrefs"]...') that post_reel.py captures internally before the composer opens. But nothing in REQ-004's outcome-JSON schema, REQ-006's unverified-routing text, or PROP-005's canonical stub JSON shapes ever specifies post_reel.py returning that list to run.sh. The REV9 refactor pseudocode itself (verification-architecture.md:29-58) stores it as a bare local variable `before = stabilize_reads(...)` and never assigns it into `res` (the dict actually printed as JSON) -- confirmed by reading the pseudocode end-to-end, and confirmed against the REAL run.sh (/Users/anicca/anicca/skills/earn/clip/run.sh:88-91), which only ever parses `post_url` out of post_reel.py's stdout JSON. A builder implementing REQ-008 step 6 literally has no data source for the sidecar's `before_hrefs` field. The one plausible workaround -- run.sh separately invoking `--verify-only` AFTER the failed/unconfirmed attempt to get a 'before' snapshot -- is actively WRONG: if the clip in fact landed but wasn't confirmed, that post-hoc snapshot would already include this clip's own href, making the self-heal diff blind to it forever (a permanent false negative). This is precisely the class of correctness gap the feature exists to eliminate, reintroduced at the JSON-schema handoff boundary between post_reel.py and run.sh.

evidence.snippet:
before = stabilize_reads(lambda: read_hrefs(tid, handle))   # local var, never put into res
...
res.update(outcome)   # only classify_outcome's keys ever reach res
-- PROP-005 stub for unverified: {"reached":"shared-unconfirmed","published":false,"outcome":"unverified","post_url":null}  (no before_hrefs field)

crossCheck.snippet: RES="$(... $POSTER ... | tail -1)"\nURL="$(printf '%s' "$RES" | ... print(d.get("post_url") or ""))"\n# run.sh parses ONLY post_url from post_reel.py's stdout -- no other field is read
